spec.title: The email at 4:59
spec.description: A fictional security exercise. Investigate an urgent email, choose a response and see the consequences.

panels.title: Your investigation
panels.body: Training scenario. Inspect the sender before deciding.

entries.label: I checked the sender address
entries.detail: The display name says IT. The sender is reset@helpdesk-example.invalid.
